title: Isolation of phosphoproteins from Aiptasia anemones for phosphoproteome analysis
author: Fabia Simona
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.txuepnw
materials: Tissue lysis and total protein extraction Note: all buffers in the protocol are made with sequencing grade chemicals and ultrapure water (Milli-Q). Protein low binding tubes are used throughout the protocol. Tissue lysis is performed on ice with ice-cold lysis buffer (to avoid protein degradation) For reference phosphoproteome assay library generation, a pool of 20 small-sized (2 mm basal disc) Aiptasia anemones per experimental condition was used to obtain sufficient proteins. Note: apo- and symbiotic anemones were processed separately throughout the entire protocol For phosphoproteome quantification a pool of 10 small-sized (2 mm basal disc) Aiptasia anemones constituted each biological replicate Lysis buffer: 8 M urea in water supplemented with protease (Cat. 4693159001; Roche Applied Science) and phosphatase (Cat. 04906845001; Roche Applied Science) inhibitors 100% methanol 100% chloroform Pierce Micro BCA Protein Assay kit (Cat. 23235; Thermo Fisher Scientific) or comparable protein quantification assay

Laboratory Equipment Protein LoBind 1.5 mg tubes (Cat. 022431081; Eppendorf) Glass 2 ml Tenbroeck Tissue Grinder (Cat. 357421; Wheaton) High-pressure Barocycler 2320EXT connected to mini chiller and FT 500–MS pulse tubes (PBI Pressure Biosciences) or Ultrasonic Processor (Thomas Scientific) Ultrasonic cleaner Thermomixer Incubator at 37°C SPE vacuum manifolds for Sep-Pak (Waters Corp.) Centrifuges at 20°C (5415R and 5810R; Eppendorf) Thermo Savant ISS110 SpeedVac System (Thermo Fisher Scientific) NanoDrop Protein Quantification (Thermo Fisher Scientific) Surveyor Plus high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) connected to an XBridge Peptide BEH C18 column, 4.6 mm ID x 250 mm length, 3.5 µm particle size, 130Å pore size (Cat. 186003570; Waters Corp.) UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano UHPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) connected to an Acclaim PepMap 100 C18 column, 75 µm ID x 250 mm length, 3 µm particle size, 100 Å pore size (Cat. 164261; Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to an Orbitrap Q-Exactive HF (Thermo Fisher Scientific) UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano UHPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) connected to an EASY-Spray column PepMap RSLC C18, 75 µm ID x 500 mm length, 2 µm particle size, 100 Å pore size (Cat. ES803; Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to a Fusion Lumos Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
Phosphopeptides preparation for LC-MS 0.1% FA, 0.1% ACN in LC-MS grade water (Cat. 1153332500; EMD Millipore) Indexed retention time (iRT) standards (Cat. Ki30021; Biognosys)
LC-MS buffers Buffer A : 0.1% FA Buffer B: 0.1% FA in 80% ACN

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract total proteins from anemones using mechanical lysis and methanol-chloroform precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Lyse anemones in 1.5 ml of lysis buffer using a Tenbroeck Tissue Grinder.
Transfer homogenate to FT 500–MS pulse tubes and disrupt at 3,000 psi (200 bar) for 30 cycles (30 min) at 4°C using a Barocycler, or alternatively sonicate 3 x 10 sec on ice with 1 min intervals.
Transfer to a 15 ml collection tube and equalize volume (Vol) with water if necessary.
Add 4 Vol of methanol, pulse vortex, and spin down.
Add 1 Vol of chloroform, pulse vortex, and spin down.
Add 3 Vol of water, pulse vortex, and spin down at 4,000 x g for 5 min to separate into aqueous, interphase (protein), and hydrophobic layers.
Remove aqueous and hydrophobic layers without disturbing the protein interphase.
Resuspend protein disc in 1 ml methanol (use additional 200 μl methanol to clean tube if needed), transfer to 1.5 ml tube, and spin down at > 20,000 x g for 1 min; discard supernatant.
Repeat the resuspension and centrifugation step once.
Dry the pellet in a SPE vacuum chamber or fume hood for ~20 min (do not use SpeedVac).
Resuspend pellet in max 250 μl fresh lysis buffer and sonicate 3 x 10 sec on ice (1 min intervals), or store at -80°C.
Quantify protein via micro BCA (suggested dilution 1:50). Use 1.5 mg for library generation or 500-750 μg for quantification.

steps.title: Filter-Aided Sample Preparation (FASP)
steps.instruction: Perform protein digestion using the FASP method to obtain peptides.

substeps.instruction: Mix 250 μg protein extract with 200 μl UA buffer (8 M urea, 0.1 M Tris/HCl pH 8.5) in a Microcon YM-10 filter unit; centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 40 min and discard flow-through.
Add 100 μl DTT solution (0.01 M DTT in UA), mix at 600 rpm for 1 min at 37°C, incubate without mixing for 5 min, then centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 30 min.
Add 100 μl IAA solution (0.05 M iodoacetamide in UA), mix at 600 rpm for 1 min at 37°C, incubate without mixing for 5 min, then centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 30 min and discard flow-through.
Add 100 μl UB buffer (8 M urea, 0.1 M Tris/HCl pH 8.0), centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 40 min; repeat once.
Add 120 μl ABC buffer (0.05 M NH4HCO3) containing Trypsin/Lys-C (1:50 enzyme-to-protein ratio), mix at 600 rpm for 1 min at 37°C, and incubate at 37°C overnight.
Transfer filter units to new tubes and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 40 min.
Add 50 μl 0.5 M NaCl and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 20 min.
Add 50 μl 1% TFA and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 20 min.
Acidify the filtrate with 2% (v/v) TFA.

steps.title: Peptide Desalting
steps.instruction: Desalt the acidified peptide filtrate using a C18 Sep-Pak cartridge and R3 resin.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend Oligo R3 resin in 200 μl 100% ACN and load into a C18 Sep-Pak cartridge (keep resin moist).
Condition the cartridge twice with 100% methanol (1 cartridge volume per wash).
Wash twice with washing buffer (0.1% TFA in water, 1 cartridge volume per wash).
Load the acidified peptide filtrate.
Wash twice with washing buffer (1 cartridge volume per wash).
For general use: Elute twice with elution buffer 1 (75% ACN, 0.1% TFA, ~300-500 μl per elution), dry in SpeedVac, and store at -80°C.
For phosphoproteome quantification: Elute twice with elution buffer 2 (80% ACN, 5% TFA, 1 M glycolic acid) and proceed directly to phosphopeptide enrichment without drying.

steps.title: Peptide Fractionation and Concatenation
steps.instruction: Fractionate peptides using HPLC and concatenate fractions for orthogonal analysis.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend peptide mixture in Buffer A (5 mM ammonium hydroxide) within LC injection limits.
Equilibrate XBridge Peptide BEH C18 column in Buffer A.

Run a 120-min gradient: 0-5% to 25% Buffer B (90% ACN, 5 mM ammonium hydroxide) in 60-90 min; 25-40% B in 5-10 min; ramp to 60-70% B in 5 min (stop collection); maintain 70% B for 5 min; ramp to 0-5% B and re-equilibrate for 5-10 min.
Collect fractions every 60 sec (~110 fractions); store at 4°C or SpeedVac.
Concatenate flow-through and last separation region fractions into two fractions; concatenate separation region fractions into 23 fractions according to the provided template.
Reduce volume to ~50 μl via SpeedVac and store at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Phosphopeptide Enrichment
steps.instruction: Enrich phosphopeptides using TiO2 beads via two different protocols depending on the goal.

substeps.instruction: Common start: Measure peptide concentration at A280 (NanoDrop) and bring fractions to 1 mL with loading buffer (80% ACN, 5% TFA, 1 M glycolic acid).
For Library Generation (A): Add TiO2 beads (washed in 100% ACN, then loading buffer) at 6:1 w/w ratio; incubate at 1,400 rpm for 10 min; centrifuge 1 min and remove supernatant.

For Quantification (B): Perform two incubations. First: 6:1 w/w TiO2 beads, 1,400 rpm for 10 min; centrifuge 1 min and transfer supernatant to new tube. Second: 3:1 w/w TiO2 beads, 1,400 rpm for 10 min; centrifuge 1 min and remove supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 80 μl loading buffer, transfer to new tube, and centrifuge for 15 sec; discard supernatant.
Wash beads with 80 μl washing buffer 1 (80% ACN, 1% TFA), mix at 1,400 rpm for 2 min, centrifuge 15 sec, and discard supernatant.
Wash beads with 50 μl washing buffer 2 (20% ACN, 0.5% TFA), mix at 1,400 rpm for 2 min, centrifuge 15 sec, and discard supernatant.
Dry beads in fume hood for 10 min or SpeedVac for 2-5 min (store at -20°C if needed).
Elute by adding 50 μl elution buffer (4% ammonia in water, pH 11), incubate at 1,400 rpm for 10 min, centrifuge 1 min, and transfer supernatant to a new tube; repeat elution once.

steps.title: Phosphopeptide Desalting via STAGE Tips
steps.instruction: Desalt enriched phosphopeptides using a custom STAGE tip.

substeps.instruction: Punch holes in C18 extraction disks with a 16 gauge needle and place material in a 200 μl tip.
Apply ~2 cm of R3 resin (resuspended in 100% ACN) on top of C18 material.
Condition twice with 100% methanol and wash twice with washing buffer (0.1% TFA in water), 1 tip volume per wash.
Acidify phosphopeptide mixture with 14% (v/v) formic acid and 4% (v/v) TFA.
Load mixture onto STAGE tip, wash twice with washing buffer (1 tip volume per wash).
Elute twice with elution buffer (75% ACN, 0.1% TFA), 50 μl per elution.

steps.title: Preparation for Shotgun Proteomics
steps.instruction: Prepare and analyze phosphopeptides using LC-MS/MS (Orbitrap Q-Exactive).

substeps.instruction: Dry eluted phosphopeptides via SpeedVac and redissolve in 0.1% FA, 0.1% ACN, LC-MS grade water; sonicate for 2 min.
Quantify at A280 and add iRT standards at 1:10 (v/w) ratio.
Use Acclaim PepMap 100 C18 column (300 nl/min) with 75-min gradient: 5-40% B in 55 min; ramp to 90% B in 5 min; maintain 90% B for 5 min; ramp to 2% B for 10 min.

MS settings: Nonospray Flex source (1.9 kV, 275 °C); Full MS scan (350-1400 m/z, res 60,000, 100 ms accumulation, target 3x10^6); HCD fragmentation of top 10 ions (>2e4 threshold, multiple charges) with res 15,000, 20 sec dynamic exclusion, 100 ms accumulation, target 1x10^5, 28% NCE, and 1.8 isolation width.

steps.title: Preparation for DIA/SWATH-MS
steps.instruction: Prepare and analyze phosphopeptides using DIA-MS (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos).

substeps.instruction: Dry eluted phosphopeptides via SpeedVac and redissolve in 0.1% FA, 0.1% ACN, LC-MS grade water; sonicate for 2 min.
Quantify at A280, normalize concentrations, and add iRT standards at 3:10 (v/w) ratio.
Use EASY-Spray column (300 nl/min) with the same 75-min gradient as library generation.

MS settings: EASY-Spray source (1.9 kV, 275 °C); Full MS scan (400-1200 m/z, res 60,000, 20 ms injection, target 5x10^5); DIA mode with 32 precursor windows (25 Da wide); HCD fragmentation at 30%, res 30,000, 50 ms injection, target 2x10^5.
